title: Egyptian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish originating from Egypt, featuring juicy lamb skewers grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: juicy
ingredients.notes: mixed with olive oil, lemon juice, and garlic

ingredients.name: briny
ingredients.notes: mixed with olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano

instructions: 2. Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
3. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano.
4. Brush the lamb skewers with the marinade, making sure they're evenly coated.
5. Sprinkle the ground cumin and coriander over the lamb skewers.
6. Grill the lamb skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
7. Let the lamb skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
8. Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or flatbread.
9. Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
10. Enjoy your delicious Egyptian Lamb Kebabs!
